'''March 2001 Munich tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Munich, Germany on 17 March 2001. [[Quirin Fürgut]] won it. It is known from Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1916">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-munich-ralltiir-3-17-01d1916/ munich-ralltiir-3-17-01], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-munich-ralltiir-3-17-01d1916/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Munich, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Quirin Fürgut]]
